paragraphs.text: A detailed obligation with enough text to wrap onto a second line in the workbench. The continuation should align with the paragraph text so that the outline remains easy to scan and compare with Microsoft Word.
An ordinary paragraph interrupts the list without restarting it.
A bullet with a hanging indent and enough words to wrap onto multiple lines. Its marker stays separate from the editable text, and the wrapped lines should line up with this text.
A list explicitly starting at five
An independent list starts at one
An indented quotation. This paragraph has left and right indentation inherited from a style, plus a first-line indent applied directly. Its source properties remain visible in the inspector.

A hanging paragraph without a list marker. This deliberately long paragraph demonstrates that indentation belongs to paragraphs in general, independently of numbering and bullets, so its wrapped lines should start farther right than its first line.
